newsitem.title: UK: Whitbread at record after S&N results.
newsitem.headline: Whitbread at record after S&N results.

text.p: Shares in Whitbread Plc touched a record high on Monday after strong results from brewer Scottish & Newcastle Plc (S&N) and after positive comment on Whitbread shares late last week, traders said.
Whitbread shares were up 9p at 775-1/2 by 1040 GMT, after earlier reaching a record 777p, surpassing their previous high of 770p set on Friday.
Scottish & Newcastle earlier today posted a 26 percent rise in half-year profits to 195.1 million stg, driven by an improvement in sales at its managed pubs and restaurants business.

Last week NatWest repeated an "add" rating on Whitbread while a report in the Financial Times said Kleinwort Benson was also positive on the company following its 46 million stg acquisition of restaurant operator BrightReasons group.
